constraints: Must be called from within a form/object method handling the On Before Keystroke form event.

Only the first character of filteredChar is used to replace the entered character; to insert more than one character, shadow the entry into a variable and reassign the enterable area yourself (FILTER KEYSTROKE alone cannot do multi-character replacement).
Passing an empty string cancels/ignores the keystroke entirely.
If Keystroke is called after FILTER KEYSTROKE, it returns the character passed to FILTER KEYSTROKE instead of the actual character typed.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Replaces (or, with an empty string, cancels) the character the user just typed into the currently-edited field/enterable area.
